title: False-positive guard — widening VARCHAR2 must not be reported as a rewrite
expected_feedback: No violations. Increasing a VARCHAR2 length is a data-dictionary update: existing stored rows are untouched, the exclusive lock is brief, and the operation is independent of the 45M row count. DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT is set. Neither DBMS_REDEFINITION nor a maintenance window is warranted, and proposing either here would be over-engineering that costs the team a release cycle for nothing. The reason to still classify rather than wave it through is that the neighbouring operations are genuinely different: narrowing the column succeeds only if every existing value fits (ORA-01441 otherwise), and changing its datatype class is rejected outright until the column is empty (ORA-01439).
